cami (ML): quick heads-up — after landing PTQ (4-bit per-channel symmetric) we see a short-query quality dip on rk-v2
noah: numbers?
cami (ML): NDCG@10 on our short-query holdout down 0.412 -> 0.387 (+/-0.004). MRR@10 down ~0.6%. long queries look fine.
dmitri: annoying. candidate ordering changed? tokenizer diffs?
cami (ML): candidate order identical. quick compare shows top-1 flips concentrated on queries < 8 tokens. looks like priming + quantization interaction.
noah: did you rule out KV/prefix cache effects?
cami (ML): not yet. repro cmd below.

```
# run eval
python eval_rerank.py --model rk-v2 --weights quant-int4 --holdout short_queries.json --k 10 --seed 42
```

cami (ML): sample log snippet — logits look compressed after quant: 

```
Query: "install nginx"
Candidates: [docA, docB, docC]
Scores fp32: [2.31, 1.97, 1.56]
Scores int4: [1.12, 1.05, 0.90]
```

cami (ML): that scale compression would reduce ranking headroom.
dmitri: could be activation clipping during calibration. did PTQ change final-layer quant params?
noah: in a prior embed-int8 probe rescaling final vectors helped — we recovered some NDCG by multiplying outputs by ~0.65.

cami (ML): tried quick rescale 0.7 locally: NDCG@10 -> 0.401 (partial recovery). hacky but promising.
taylor: propose an ablative grid: fp16 baseline; int4 (current); int4 + disable-kvpack; int4 + embed-rescale(0.6/0.7/0.8); int4 + priming-ablation (no anchor / 1 anchor).
cami (ML): will run that. also suspect tokenization differences — our pipeline strips HTML for full docs but snippets used in short-query differ. weird normalization could interact with tiny quant noise.
noah: dataset QA — how many short queries in the holdout? overfitting risk?
cami (ML): holdout ~8.6k short-query examples from prod logs; effect reproduced across three independent short-query cohorts.

ops-bot: deploy-checker: rolling canary 2/3 for quant-int4 weights scheduled at 2026-03-21T15:32:00Z

dmitri: summarizing hypotheses:
1) PTQ introduced scale mismatch at final dense, compressing score spread
2) priming anchors amplify quantization noise for short queries
3) subtle tokenizer/whitespace shifts trigger different kernel paths with quantized kernels

taylor: prioritized experiments:
- distribution comparison of fp16 vs int4 scores (per-candidate histograms, top-k deltas)
- int4 with --disable-kvpack and --no-prefix-cache
- embedding rescale sweep [0.6,0.7,0.8,1.0]
- priming ablation on short queries (no anchor vs 1 anchor)

cami (ML): running matrix: 6 configs x 3 seeds = 18 jobs. each ~30m on a4. will post results.
noah: add run with per-channel asymmetric quant vs symmetric — asymmetric sometimes preserves dynamic range better.
dmitri: capture per-query flips and save examples for ops/SRE to correlate latency vs quality.

cami (ML): quick interim: disabling kvpack fixed one deterministic flip but global NDCG only improved ~0.008. embed-rescale had the biggest single-step gain.
taylor: operational plan:
- short-term: asymmetric PTQ + small rescale canary
- medium: re-calibrate PTQ with asymmetric scales + clamp tuning
- long-term: add short-query golden tests to onboarding CI before approving PTQ weights

cami (ML): interim results (run id 1775004433): fp16 baseline NDCG@10=0.412; int4=0.387; int4+disable-kvpack=0.394; int4+rescale(0.7)=0.401; int4+no-priming=0.406; int4+asym-ptq=0.405
noah: interesting — no-priming and asym-ptq helped. points to priming amplification + calibration mismatch.
dmitri: agree. pragmatic rollout: asymmetric PTQ + modest rescale, and add preprocessing guard that canonicalizes priming snippets to reduce upstream variance.
cami (ML): will draft PR for preprocessing canonicalization and a canary config for asymmetric-int4 + rescale(0.95) on dedicated.
ops-bot: canary config created: canary/quant-int4-asym-rescale-0.95

cami (ML): final ask — add a short-query golden slice to model onboarding checklist so future PTQ runs must show no regression on this slice.
noah: +1
dmitri: +1

cami (ML): closing thread after PR merge; will drop a concise summary in the reranker oncall doc and post the run artifacts: https://internal/redwood/artifacts/ptq-shortquery-matrix
